claims.text: A cancellation fee is chargeable only if the driver carries all four limbs of POL-NS-01: a recorded 'arrived' event; a gps_trace placing him inside the POL-NS-02 geofence at or before that event; a continuous in-geofence hold of at least the zone minimum, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap; and a driver-side termination on a recognised reason code at or after the dwell elapsed. The rider's position is that each limb must be established on this trip's own admissible evidence, and that the failure of any single limb takes the fee out of POL-NS-01 altogether and sends the outcome to POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 or POL-NS-06 as applicable.

The charge does not turn on where the rider was. POL-NS-01 tests only the driver's arrival, in-geofence position, dwell and termination; rider position appears nowhere in it, and POL-NS-06 makes the shortfall refund payable 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The rider's device sat at 519.47 m from the pin for the whole waiting window, outside the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius, and that fact goes only to POL-NS-04(c) - it cannot be used to make out the charge against the rider.

The rider does not contest proximity and does not press POL-NS-05. On the driver's own trace all 51 in-geofence fixes fall inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius (derived mean distance from the pin 24.011 m), and the qualifying run begins at 22:40:00, before the 22:40:20 'arrived' event, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and POL-NS-01 limb (b) is met. At the arrival timestamp the trace shows the driver stationary at 0.0 km/h well within 300 m of the pin, so the marker is not false under POL-NS-05 and there is no recomputation of the waiting clock.

The rider likewise does not press POL-NS-06. The minimum dwell for the AIRPORT zone class is 480 seconds, and the longest continuous in-geofence run measures 500 seconds, from the first qualifying fix at 22:40:00 to the cancellation at 22:48:20 - a surplus of 20 seconds (the derived shortfall is -20.0 seconds). There is therefore no shortfall to refund under POL-NS-06 and no limb (i) accumulation question is reached.

POL-NS-04 does not apply on this record. The rider sent one message, at 22:41:40 ('I am walking over now'), and the driver replied at 22:41:58, eighteen seconds later, so limb (b) fails and the clause is displaced 'regardless of the content of the reply'. Limb (c) fails as well: the rider track places the device at 519.47 m from the pin, outside the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius, with zero qualifying fixes. The rider's explanation that Changi T3 is large and the walk to the bay is long is a point about the terminal's internal geography; the record carries no venue geometry for that walk, and the rider does not rest the point on general knowledge of the airport's layout.

No traffic advisory is available on this record, and the rider discloses that plainly: EV-ADVIS-09102-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT is recorded against it. The driver therefore cannot rely on POL-NS-06(i) to sum separate in-geofence intervals, and in any event the trace shows a single in-geofence interval. The rider cites the absent advisory only to close that route off and builds no part of this case on it.

claims.text: The driver arrived inside the pickup geofence. His own GPS trace carries 51 fixes and the maximum distance from the pickup pin across the whole trace is 24.0 m, so every fix falls inside the 150 m arrival radius the fee schedule sets for the AIRPORT zone class. POL-NS-02's requirement of at least three consecutive in-radius fixes is satisfied many times over, and the trip record independently carries the driver 'arrived' event at 22:40:20.

The dwell requirement is met. The longest continuous qualifying in-geofence run is 500 seconds, running from 22:40:00 to 22:48:20, against the 480-second minimum dwell for the AIRPORT zone class - a margin of 20 seconds. Under POL-NS-01 limb (c) that clock runs from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' tap, and it still clears the minimum.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold on this record. Limb (a): the trip record contains a driver 'arrived' event at 22:40:20. Limb (b): the trace places the driver 24.0 m from the pin at and before that timestamp, inside the arrival radius. Limb (c): 500 seconds of continuous in-geofence dwell against a 480-second minimum. Limb (d): the record shows no boarding event and the trip terminated by the driver at 22:48:20 - 20 seconds after the required dwell elapsed - with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises.

The arrival marker is not a false arrival marker under POL-NS-05. Matched to the 22:40:20 'arrived' event, the trace places the driver 24.0 m from the pickup pin, far inside the 300 m threshold, and the only speed recorded across the entire trace is 0.0 km/h, below the 15 km/h motion threshold. There is therefore no recomputation of the waiting clock and no false-arrival finding against the driver.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because limb (b) fails outright. The rider wrote 'I am walking over now.' at 22:41:40 and the driver answered 'Okay, I will remain at Door 5.' at 22:41:58 - 18 seconds later, well within the 120-second reply window, and the driver placed no in-app call but had no need to. Where the driver replied inside 120 seconds the clause does not apply at all, whatever the reply said.

POL-NS-04 limb (c) is also affirmatively failed on admissible fixes, so the rider-exonerating route is doubly closed. The rider's own track places the rider's device 519.5 m from the pickup pin on its 24 fixes, and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 - no fix at all falls inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius, let alone a majority of qualifying fixes across the waiting window.

There is no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06. The effective in-geofence dwell is 500 seconds against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum; the trace reports a shortfall of -20 seconds, meaning the minimum is met, so the cancellation fee is chargeable and no full refund follows. The driver does not assert limb (i) accumulation at all: the trace shows a single in-geofence interval with no excursions, and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09102-01 is MISSING with admissibility weight 0.0 and no payload - it carries no fact and is named here only to record that no accumulation against it is claimed.

The wrong-entrance clause does not displace the fee. POL-NS-03 governs only where the driver was stationary outside the 150 m arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; here the driver's stationary fixes sit 24.0 m from the pin, inside the radius, so POL-NS-03 is not engaged and the event is decided under POL-NS-01.

The driver is owed compensation on the verified no-show. POL-NS-01 being satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 sets compensation at 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee, that is SGD 4.80. The anti-farming check does not bite: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the four-termination limb, and 1 divided by 120 completed_trips_30d is 0.008, below the 0.08 rate limb - and the clause requires both limbs, so compensation is not withheld.

The charge reconciles with the fee schedule, so there is no fare defect and no POL-NS-08(d) impairment of the money evidence. The AIRPORT zone-class fee is SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee is SGD 6.00; the fare breakdown's cancellation_fee line of SGD 6.00 equals the greater of the two, which is the figure POL-NS-01's resolution rule prescribes.

No escalation trigger is engaged, so a monetary ruling is available and the fee need not be held. Neither profile shows disputes_with_counterparty_90d (both 0), rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check has not tripped, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire. The arrival and dwell facts rest solely on artifacts at admissibility weight 1.0, so nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d) either.

No POL-GEN-02 discount applies to the driver's case. Every artifact the driver relies on - the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log, the fare breakdown and both profiles - carries admissibility weight 1.0 with no issue codes, and the trace's 10-second cadence is uniform with max_gap_sec of 0.0. The only artifact below 1.0 in the bundle is the MISSING traffic advisory at weight 0.0, on which no claim rests, so the deciding facts are carried by full-weight evidence.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the SGD 6.00 airport no-show fee stands as charged, and the driver is paid SGD 4.80 in compensation. The rider's claim is not supported.

Why the fee stands. POL-NS-01 requires four things and all four hold on the platform's own records. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 22:40:20. (b) The GPS trace puts all 51 of its fixes within 24 m of the pickup pin — far inside the 150 m airport arrival radius — beginning at 22:40:00, before the arrival event, so POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-qualifying-fix test is satisfied many times over and clock skew is nil (the arrival event sits within a second of a fix). (c) The dwell clock runs from the first qualifying fix at 22:40:00, not from the arrival tap, to the cancellation at 22:48:20 — 500 continuous seconds against the 480-second airport minimum, a 20-second margin. (d) No boarding event is recorded and the driver terminated the trip at 22:48:20, after the 480 seconds elapsed at 22:48:00, on RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises.

Rider's points. The rider's explanation that Changi T3 is large and the walk to the bay is long does not change the outcome. POL-NS-01 tests only the driver's arrival, in-geofence position, dwell and termination; the rider's whereabouts appear nowhere in it. POL-NS-06 also makes no refund turn on rider presence, but it is not triggered here because there is no shortfall. The rider's device sat 519 m from the pin with zero qualifying fixes, but that fact goes only to POL-NS-04(c) and cannot found the charge either way.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. It needs an unanswered rider message AND rider presence within the 200 m airport radius. The driver replied 'Okay, I will remain at Door 5' 18 seconds after the rider's 22:41:40 message, so limb (b) fails outright, and the rider's track shows 519 m with zero qualifying fixes, so limb (c) fails as well.

Other rider routes are closed on the evidence: POL-NS-05 finds no false arrival marker — the driver was stationary (0.0 km/h) 24 m from the pin at the arrival timestamp, far inside the 300 m threshold — and POL-NS-03 is not engaged, because the driver's stationary fixes are inside the 150 m arrival radius rather than outside it but within 400 m. POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable in any event: the trace shows a single in-geofence interval and the traffic advisory is missing.

Impairment and confidence. Nothing the ruling rests on is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d): the trace has no gaps (51 fixes, max gap 0.0 s), the chat log holds exactly the 4 messages the trip record counts with sequential IDs, arrival and termination times agree between trace and record, and the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee equals the greater of the airport zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00), so there is no fare defect. The only sub-weight artifact, the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09102-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), was cited only to close off POL-NS-06(i); it carries no fact this ruling uses, so it does not lower the confidence cap, which is 1.0 from the full-weight artifacts that carry the deciding facts.

No escalation. None of POL-NS-09(a)–(e) fires: no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; both profiles show 0 disputes with the counterparty in 90 days and 0 no-show disputes in 30 days; and the anti-farming check has not tripped.

Driver compensation. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, i.e. SGD 4.80. The anti-farming check requires BOTH limbs and neither is met: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below four) and 1/120 completed trips is 0.008 (below 0.08). Compensation is therefore paid, and per POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd carrying the same SGD 4.80 figure; the rider's charge stands (NO_ACTION as to the fee). No profile field other than the POL-NS-07 and POL-NS-09 counters was used, so no context-only profile field carried any finding, and no clause produces a referral on these facts.

Your walking argument does not open a rider-exonerating route: POL-NS-04 requires that the driver neither reply within 120 seconds nor call, but the driver answered 'Okay, I will remain at Door 5' at 22:41:58, 18 seconds after your 22:41:40 message, so that clause is displaced regardless of the reply's content. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because limb (b) fails outright. The rider wrote 'I am walking over now.' at 22:41:40 and the driver answered 'Okay, I will remain at Door 5.' at 22:41:58 - 18 seconds later, well within the 120-second reply window, and the driver placed no in-app call but had no need to. Where the driver replied inside 120 seconds the clause does not apply at all, whatever the reply said.

POL-NS-04 limb (c) is also affirmatively failed on admissible fixes, so the rider-exonerating route is doubly closed. The rider's own track places the rider's device 519.5 m from the pickup pin on its 24 fixes, and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 - no fix at all falls inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius, let alone a majority of qualifying fixes across the waiting window.

There is no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06. The effective in-geofence dwell is 500 seconds against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum; the trace reports a shortfall of -20 seconds, meaning the minimum is met, so the cancellation fee is chargeable and no full refund follows. The driver does not assert limb (i) accumulation at all: the trace shows a single in-geofence interval with no excursions, and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09102-01 is MISSING with admissibility weight 0.0 and no payload - it carries no fact and is named here only to record that no accumulation against it is claimed.

ledger.claim: The wrong-entrance clause does not displace the fee. POL-NS-03 governs only where the driver was stationary outside the 150 m arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; here the driver's stationary fixes sit 24.0 m from the pin, inside the radius, so POL-NS-03 is not engaged and the event is decided under POL-NS-01.

The driver is owed compensation on the verified no-show. POL-NS-01 being satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 sets compensation at 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee, that is SGD 4.80. The anti-farming check does not bite: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the four-termination limb, and 1 divided by 120 completed_trips_30d is 0.008, below the 0.08 rate limb - and the clause requires both limbs, so compensation is not withheld.

The charge reconciles with the fee schedule, so there is no fare defect and no POL-NS-08(d) impairment of the money evidence. The AIRPORT zone-class fee is SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee is SGD 6.00; the fare breakdown's cancellation_fee line of SGD 6.00 equals the greater of the two, which is the figure POL-NS-01's resolution rule prescribes.

No escalation trigger is engaged, so a monetary ruling is available and the fee need not be held. Neither profile shows disputes_with_counterparty_90d (both 0), rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check has not tripped, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire. The arrival and dwell facts rest solely on artifacts at admissibility weight 1.0, so nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d) either.

No POL-GEN-02 discount applies to the driver's case. Every artifact the driver relies on - the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log, the fare breakdown and both profiles - carries admissibility weight 1.0 with no issue codes, and the trace's 10-second cadence is uniform with max_gap_sec of 0.0. The only artifact below 1.0 in the bundle is the MISSING traffic advisory at weight 0.0, on which no claim rests, so the deciding facts are carried by full-weight evidence.
